summary: Tested backend endpoints powering the new mobile LeadDetailScreen features: post-call outcome logging (POST /api/call-logs) and quick status update (PUT /api/leads/{id}). 20/20 pytest cases passed. Mobile React Native UI itself cannot be exercised in the web preview; verified via code review that the screen wires up to backend correctly.

minor.issue: LeadUpdate.status is Optional[str] with no enum validation — any string is accepted, including invalid statuses. Consider Literal['new','follow_up','not_interested','leads','file'].
outcome is a free-form string; there is no enum validation preventing arbitrary outcome values (mismatch risk vs /call-outcomes list).

integration_issues.issue: handleSubmitCallOutcome performs POST /call-logs then a separate PUT /leads/{id} for status. Not atomic — if the status PUT fails after log succeeds, UI still shows generic error but lead status won't be updated. Consider a combined endpoint or rollback.

action_items: (Optional) Add enum/Literal validation for LeadUpdate.status and CallLogCreate.outcome in backend/models/schemas.py
(Optional) Combine call-log create + status update into one backend endpoint for atomicity
Mobile UI itself (React Native) needs manual verification on device — cannot be automated in web preview
critical_code_review_comments: LeadDetailScreen.js: Post-call modal fires on ANY app returning to foreground after tapping Call (even if user just switched apps without calling). >3s threshold is a weak heuristic; false positives likely.
LeadDetailScreen.js handleSubmitCallOutcome does 2 API calls (POST /call-logs, PUT /leads/{id}) sequentially without transaction — partial success possible.

api.js logCallOutcome does not send duration; schema allows it (Optional) but for reporting/daily_sessions.total_call_seconds this manual log always contributes 0 seconds even when 'connected'. Consider capturing a duration in the modal.
Backend LeadUpdate + CallLogCreate lack enum validation for status/outcome — silent data quality issue.

success_rate.frontend: N/A - React Native cannot be tested in web preview

seed_data_creation: Created + auto-deleted a TEST_CallOutcome Lead assigned to agent. Multiple call_logs entries were created against this lead during test run; deleted with the lead teardown, but underlying call_logs docs may remain in DB (call_logs are not cascade-deleted on lead delete).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints for the new mobile features are verified working: POST /api/call-logs accepts all 7 outcomes (connected, no_answer, switched_off, not_connecting, busy, wrong_number, voicemail); PUT /api/leads/{id} accepts all 5 statuses (new, follow_up, not_interested, leads, file) and persists them. GET /api/leads/{id}/call-logs returns logged outcomes. Mobile app is React Native so UI must be verified on device build. Note call_logs orphan on lead delete — cleanup consideration.
